# Zhixuan

> Zhixuan is a one-person online studio offering four fixed-price services, delivered in writing by email, worldwide: brand & baby naming, BaZi + Zi Wei chart readings, Western astrology natal chart readings, and contract review & legal-risk checks. All prices are in USD. The main contact and ordering channel is email: zhixuan559@gmail.com. Services can also be ordered through the Fiverr and Kwork listings below.

## Services

- [Brand & Baby Naming](https://zhixuan559-beep.github.io/services/naming.html): Original name ideas for businesses, products, and babies, each with pronunciation, origin, and layered meaning notes, plus a ranked recommendation. Tiers: $30 (5 names), $100 (10 names, full breakdowns), $150 (adds tagline options and handle/domain availability notes). Delivery: 1–3 days.
- [BaZi and Zi Wei Chart Reading](https://zhixuan559-beep.github.io/services/bazi-ziwei-reading.html): A long-form written reading of a client's BaZi (Four Pillars) and Zi Wei Dou Shu charts in plain English — career, wealth, relationships, and 10-year luck-cycle timing. Tiers: $30 (overview), $100 (full reading), $150 (full reading plus follow-up questions). Requires birth date, birth time, birth city, and gender. Delivery: 1–3 days.
- [Astrology Chart Reading](https://zhixuan559-beep.github.io/services/astrology-reading.html): A written Western natal chart reading covering Sun, Moon, rising sign, planetary placements by sign and house, and major aspects. From $30; exact price confirmed by email before payment. Requires birth date, birth time, and birth city. Delivery: 1–3 days.
- [Contract Review & Legal-Risk Check](https://zhixuan559-beep.github.io/services/contract-review.html): A clause-by-clause review of freelance, service, and small-business contracts; risky terms are flagged in plain English with suggested alternative wording. Tiers: $50 (risk scan), $100 (full review), $150 (full review plus redline-style edits). Delivery: within 2 days. This is a risk-spotting service, not a law firm and not legal advice.

## How to order

- Email zhixuan559@gmail.com with the service you want. You receive a reply confirming the tier, the fixed price, the information needed, and the delivery date. Payment is one fixed price, paid before work starts. There are no calls, meetings, or subscriptions.
- Or order through a platform listing below.

## Selected work

- [Selected Work](https://zhixuan559-beep.github.io/work.html): Brand identity concept boards (KAVORA coffee, MOONLUME skincare, KLYMB fitness, UMIKA sushi) and a full written naming sample (EMBERWYN, prepared for a fictional candle-studio brief). Portfolio pieces are studio concept work and written samples.
